USER_CONTEXT: Fix Django bug related to `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup` and `has_select_fields` interaction when `alias()` is used (issue django-16032). Contract requires editing both `django/db/models/fields/related_lookups.py` and `django/db/models/sql/query.py`.

TASK_TRACKING: No explicit task IDs provided.

COMPLETED:
- Explored `RelatedIn` class in `django/db/models/fields/related_lookups.py` (lines 75-149): `get_prep_lookup` (76-109), `as_sql` (111-149)
- Explored `Query` methods in `django/db/models/sql/query.py`: `set_values` (2383-2432), `clear_select_clause` (2092-2098), `has_select_fields` (267-270), `add_fields` (2124-2173), `set_annotation_mask` (2360-2366), `set_select` (2113-2115), `clear_select_fields` (2100-2106), `add_annotation` (1109-1119), `append_annotation_mask` (2368-2370), `annotation_select` (2435-2452), `has_filters` (561-562), `table_alias`/`ref_alias`/`unref_alias`/`change_aliases`/`get_initial_alias`
- Root cause identified: `alias()` calls `add_annotation(select=False)` → `set_annotation_mask(set(self.annotation_select).difference({alias}))`, converting `annotation_select_mask` from `None` to explicit set. This makes `has_select_fields` return True, causing `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup` to skip `clear_select_clause()`.

PENDING:
- Implement fix in `django/db/models/sql/query.py` (planned: `set_annotation_mask` should reset mask to `None` when it contains all annotations; `has_select_fields` should account for aliases)
- Implement fix in `django/db/models/fields/related_lookups.py` (`RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup`)
- Run tests to verify
